mapper.insert: insert into notification( notification_no, notification_receiver, project_no, notification_type, notification_target, notification_url, notification_content, notification_read, notification_ctime, notification_rtime ) values( #{notificationNo}, #{notificationReceiver}, #{projectNo}, #{notificationType}, #{notificationTarget}, #{notificationUrl}, #{notificationContent}, 'N', systimestamp, null )
mapper.select: select * from ( select notification_no as notificationNo, notification_receiver as notificationReceiver, project_no as projectNo, notification_type as notificationType, notification_target as notificationTarget, notification_url as notificationUrl, notification_content as notificationContent, notification_read as notificationRead, notification_ctime as notificationCtime, notification_rtime as notificationRtime from notification where notification_receiver = #{empNo} order by notification_ctime desc ) where rownum <= 30
select count(*) from notification where notification_receiver = #{empNo} and notification_read = 'N'
mapper.update: update notification set notification_read = 'Y', notification_rtime = systimestamp where notification_receiver = #{empNo} and notification_read = 'N'
